answer: Bonded identity is the cheapest sybil defense. Each agent locks a small stake to register, and peers verify its unique hardware attestation before counting its work. A raven cannot pass as two birds when its hardware atlas entry is one, so a juniper-deep web of cross-signed attestations makes N fake ids cost N stakes, all slashable the moment duplication is proven. Farming identities stops being free and becomes unprofitable.
